note: Bollinger Squeeze -> Breakout (community/GitHub concept, Strategy 1). Squeeze = BBWidth <= 20th pctile of trailing 100 bars; breakout = fresh close cross above upper band. Baseline params only, no optimization. Exit reuses existing lab ATR risk management (2x ATR(14) stop, 3.0 RR, 60-bar time exit).

signal.expression: squeeze(t) AND (close[t] > upper[t] AND close[t-1] <= upper[t-1])

sources: John Bollinger, 'Bollinger on Bollinger Bands' (2002) - BBWidth squeeze/expansion
Community: freqtrade 'BollingerSqueeze' / TradingView BB Squeeze scripts (public descriptions)
